faqs.q: What products can I sell with a California Type 20 beer and wine license in Fresno County?
faqs.a: With a Type 20 license, you can sell beer, malt beverages, and wine in sealed containers for off-site consumption at your Fresno County retail location. Spirits and distilled liquor are not authorized under this license.

faqs.q: Can I sell chilled beer and wine to go with a Type 20 license in Fresno?
faqs.a: Yes. Chilled beer and wine sales are standard for Type 20 licensees, especially at convenience stores and gas stations. You must still comply with ABC rules and local regulations regarding age verification, display, and hours of sale.

faqs.q: Do I need a minimum percentage of grocery or food sales for a Type 20 license in Fresno County?
faqs.a: There is no single statewide percentage requirement written into the Type 20 statute, but ABC and local jurisdictions look at your overall business model. Your store should clearly function as a legitimate retail operation, not an unlicensed bar. We help you align your product mix and layout with the expectations for a retail off-sale license.

faqs.q: Can I transfer a Type 20 license when I buy or sell a store in Fresno County?
faqs.a: Yes. Type 20 licenses are often transferred along with the sale of a convenience store, market, or fuel station. Transfers require ABC approval, background review, and public posting. Properly coordinating escrow and license transfer prevents gaps in your ability to sell beer and wine.

faqs.a: Plan for several months from application to final approval. ABC review workload, local approvals, build-out schedules, and any protests can all affect timing. Starting early and submitting complete, accurate paperwork is one of the best ways to keep your project on schedule.
